native_commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
import subprocess
import sys
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

@click.command
def main():
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', 'import sys; print(\"foo\", file=sys.stderr)'], stdout=sys.stderr)

result = CliRunner().invoke(main, [], catch_exceptions=False)
print('exit', result.exit_code)
print('stderr', result.stderr.strip())
print('output', result.output.strip())
PY"
